item.hypothesis: 10 % packet loss on the backend node will cause checkout and payment RPC failures, reducing completed orders.
item.reason: node fault touches every backend (map) and checkout flow depends on payment & Kafka (service‑facts).

analysis.what_happened: Backend packet loss spiked checkout p95 from 48ms to 8125ms, errors to 8%, though shop stayed online per probe data.
analysis.why: Checkout sequences charge card then ship; packet loss blocks shipping/quote calls, causing errors and p95 spikes, per service-facts.

item.hypothesis: Killing the valkey‑cart pod wipes all in‑memory carts, leading customers to abandon their purchases.
item.reason: cart store has no persistence; frontend /api/cart calls valkey‑cart (service‑facts).

analysis.what_happened: Pod kill erased in‑memory cart items (1→0), shop recovered instantly (0.0s), no data loss, SLO preserved
analysis.why: valkey-cart has no volume (memory only); pod loss immediately loses cart state with no persistent impact, per service-facts

item.hypothesis: Adding +200 ms latency on all backend egress will increase checkout latency, causing higher cart abandonment.
